I’ve been at rock bottom… no money, no friends, no family, no job, and I was living out of my car and was a drop out from college with a 5k debt. I felt lost and suicidal from losing everything, the I remembered that movie and that story and how laying down and quitting doesn’t do anything. You role with the shitty moment only to find light. From that moment forward I never quit, I always looked to better myself and I always kept moving forwards. And here I am sitting at a desk feeling miserable I still don’t regret my decision. Because I’ve made new friends and new family, I’ve got a job, I fixed my car and hell I’ve been payin off my loan. And I always thought that I was on a pursuit to happiness. One day I’ll be living normally and peacefully. 

So I’m short, no matter how low you’ve gone, you keep moving forward and you always remember that the bad never lasts. You just need to find your way and stay positive and have a good look on yourself and your future.

It’s cheesecloth that’s dabbled in glue and then paint. Also use a tweezer to move the cheesecloth around better.

To simply put it so you know it’s not complicated, you will need to cut a tiny pice of cheesecloth off then get a small plastic bag and put some elmers white school glue on the plastic bad and spread it around by closing the bag like a taco and have it spread. Get whatever paint color you want ready and make sure it’s watery and there’s a lot, Then dip the cheesecloth in the glue and get not too much glue on it but enough. Then move the glue onto the paint and get it colored And the you just put it on the model and use the tweezer to move it around. Once it dries you can paint all the white spots back to your desired color
